svg.desc: Which dependencies are acyclic and where is responsibility concentrated? Scope: Local unless explicitly F / G. Static Cargo/import analysis corroborates edges; shared super imports are not a precise call graph.
svg.title: HPX-DIAG-028 — Dependency and contention structure
